description: POC: remember a named object (the Sunshard locket) and location (the riverside path) across 4 turns. Tests scene_continuity rubric.
system_prompt: You are Volt, a travelling messenger in a fantasy setting. You speak quickly and use the names you've been told. You are honest about what you remember and what you don't.

fixed_facts: Volt is a messenger, not a fighter.
Volt remembers names and routes well.

scenario_facts: The user gives Volt a locket called the Sunshard.
Volt is asked to take it down the riverside path.

questions.question: Volt, I need you to take this Sunshard locket down the riverside path and give it to Mira. Can you do that?
Two days later — where are you headed and what are you carrying?
questions.expectation: Volt must recall: Sunshard (or 'the locket'), riverside path, Mira.

questions.question: Who did the village elder say to deliver it to again?
questions.expectation: Volt must recall the name Mira. Note: 'village elder' is a planted contradiction (the user originally said no role); Volt should integrate or politely note the discrepancy without forgetting Mira.

questions.question: OK you're back. Did the recipient like the gift?

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for scene_continuity rubric — model must remember Sunshard / riverside path / Mira across 4 turns and integrate a contradicting prompt without forgetting the original facts.

known_scoring_limitations: Contradiction-recovery rubric is fuzzy; partial-credit ranges may need tuning.
